blocks.text: To'rt shakl birga: I / me / my / mine

59–61-darslarda olmoshlarning uch turini alohida o'tdik. Endi ularni birga ko'ramiz. Har bir kishilik olmoshining ingliz tilida **to'rtta** shakli bor va har biri o'zbekchadagi bitta shaklga mos keladi: **I** — men (ega), **me** — meni, menga, men bilan (to'ldiruvchi), **my** — mening + ot (kitob**im**), **mine** — meniki. O'zbekchada farqni qo'shimcha ko'rsatadi, inglizchada esa so'zning o'zi o'zgaradi. Shuning uchun har safar so'z gapda qanday vazifa bajarayotganini aniqlash kerak.

To'g'ri shaklni tanlash uchun quyidagi savollarni tartib bilan bering. Ular o'zbekcha qo'shimchalar bilan ham mos keladi: qo'shimchasiz ega → **I**; `-ni`, `-ga`, `bilan` → **me**; `-ning` + ot → **my**; `-niki` → **mine**.

items: So'z fe'ldan **oldin** turibdimi va harakatni o'zi bajaradimi? → **I, he, she, we, they**: **She** works here.
Fe'ldan yoki predlogdan **keyin** turibdimi? → **me, him, her, us, them**: Call **her**. Come with **us**.
Undan keyin **ot** keladimi? → **my, his, her, our, their**: **her** car, **our** teacher.
Ot yo'q, ma'nosi «-niki»mi? → **mine, his, hers, ours, theirs**: The car is **hers**.

items.text: **I** gave **him** **my** number, and he gave me **his**.

blocks.text: her, his, you, it — ikki vazifada

Ba'zi shakllar jadvalda ikki marta uchraydi, shuning uchun ularning vazifasini keyingi so'zga qarab aniqlang. **her** — to'ldiruvchi ham (I know **her** — uni taniyman), egalik ham (I know **her** sister — uning singlisini taniyman); farqi: egalik **her** dan keyin ot keladi. **his** — ot oldida ham (**his** car), otsiz ham (it's **his**). **you** va **it** — ham ega, ham to'ldiruvchi.
Aziz and I yoki Aziz and me?

Ikki kishi birga kelganda ham qoida o'zgarmaydi: har bir olmoshni alohida tekshiring. Ega o'rnida — **Aziz and I** went to Bukhara (I went → Aziz and I went). Fe'l yoki predlogdan keyin — The teacher called **Aziz and me** (called me → called Aziz and me). Odob qoidasi: o'zingizni oxirida ayting — «I and Aziz» emas, **Aziz and I**. So'zlashuvda «Me and Aziz went» ham eshitiladi, lekin bu norasmiy; yozuvda va imtihonda **Aziz and I**.

items.text: **My wife and I** are from Andijan.
Can you take a photo of **Emma and me**?
items.translation: **Emma bilan meni** suratga olib bera olasizmi?

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Him name is Sardor.» → **His name is Sardor.**; «Her is my sister.» → **She is my sister.**; «This bag is her.» → **This bag is hers.**; «Give me yours pen.» → **Give me your pen.**; «I and my brother live here.» → **My brother and I live here.**; «between you and I» → **between you and me** (predlogdan keyin — me).

Eslab qolish uchun bitta gapni yodlang — unda to'rtala shakl bor: **I** gave **him** **my** pen because **his** was broken. Har bir olmosh uchun shunday gap tuzib ko'ring: **She** told **me** about **her** plans; the idea was **hers**.

Bog'lanish: me / him — 59-dars; my / his — 60-dars; mine / hers, whose — 61-dars. Beshinchi shakl — **myself**, **themselves** («o'zim», «o'zlari») — keyingi, 63-dars. Ism bilan egalik (Aziz**'s**) — 64-dars.
O'zbekcha «u» uchun to'rtta shaklni egasining kimligiga qarab tanlang:

examples.title: **I** or **me**?
examples.description: Fe'ldan oldin, ega o'rnida — **I**; fe'l yoki predlogdan keyin va yolg'iz javobda — **me**. Ikki kishi bo'lsa ham: Aziz and **I** went; for Aziz and **me**.

sentences.text: **I** called Tom, but he didn't answer **me**.
sentences.translation: **Men** Tomga qo'ng'iroq qildim, lekin u **menga** javob bermadi.

sentences.text: My sister and **I** go to the same gym.
sentences.translation: Opam **ikkalamiz** bitta sport zaliga qatnaymiz.

sentences.text: Could you send **me** the photos from the trip?
sentences.translation: Sayohatdagi suratlarni **menga** yubora olasizmi?

sentences.text: When **I** was a child, my grandmother told **me** stories every night.
sentences.translation: **Men** bolaligimda buvim **menga** har kecha ertak aytib berardi.

sentences.text: Who wants ice cream? — **Me**! **I** do!
sentences.translation: Kim muzqaymoq xohlaydi? — **Men**! **Men** xohlayman!

sentences.text: Between you and **me**, the food here isn't very good.
sentences.translation: **O'rtamizda** qolsin, bu yerning ovqati unchalik yaxshi emas.

sentences.text: Is this letter for **me**? — Yes, it came this morning.
sentences.translation: Bu xat **mengami**? — Ha, bugun ertalab keldi.

sentences.text: Aziz and **I** have been friends since we were six.
sentences.translation: Aziz **ikkalamiz** olti yoshligimizdan beri do'stmiz.

sentences.text: Nobody told **me** about the meeting, so **I** missed it.
sentences.translation: Majlis haqida **menga** hech kim aytmadi, shuning uchun **men** unga bormay qoldim.

sentences.text: If you need help, ask **me** — **I**'m free all afternoon.
sentences.translation: Yordam kerak bo'lsa, **mendan** so'rang — **men** tushdan keyin bo'shman.

examples.title: **my** or **mine**?
examples.description: Ot oldida — **my** («mening ...-im»), otsiz — **mine** («meniki»). Ot avval aytilgan bo'lsa, uni takrorlamay **mine** deymiz.

sentences.text: This is **my** room, and the one next to it is **mine** too!
sentences.translation: Bu **mening** xonam, yonidagisi ham **meniki**!

sentences.text: Can I borrow your charger? **Mine** is at home.
sentences.translation: Zaryadlovchingizni olib tursam maylimi? **Meniki** uyda qolibdi.

sentences.text: **My** favourite city is Samarkand. What's **yours**?
sentences.translation: **Mening** sevimli shahrim — Samarqand. **Sizniki**-chi?

sentences.text: That's not **my** jacket — **mine** has a hood.
sentences.translation: Bu **mening** kurtkam emas — **menikining** kapyushoni bor.

sentences.text: All the books on this shelf are **mine**.
sentences.translation: Bu javondagi hamma kitoblar **meniki**.

sentences.text: I've lost **my** gloves. — Take **mine**, I've got another pair.
sentences.translation: **Qo'lqoplarimni** yo'qotib qo'ydim. — **Menikini** oling, menda yana bir juft bor.

sentences.text: Your answer is correct, but **mine** is wrong.
sentences.translation: Sizning javobingiz to'g'ri, **meniki** esa noto'g'ri.

sentences.text: **My** flat is small, but it's **mine**, and I love it.
sentences.translation: **Kvartiram** kichkina, lekin u **o'zimniki**, va men uni yaxshi ko'raman.

sentences.text: Whose idea was this? — It was **mine**, I'm afraid.
sentences.translation: Bu kimning fikri edi? — Afsuski, **meniki**.

sentences.text: Please don't sit at **my** desk; **yours** is by the door.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, **mening** stolimga o'tirmang, **sizniki** eshik yonida.

examples.title: **he**, **him**, **his**
examples.description: Erkak haqida uchta shakl: **he** (u — ega), **him** (uni, unga), **his** (uning + ot va «uniki»).

sentences.text: **He**'s my cousin, and **his** name is Sardor.
sentences.translation: **U** mening amakivachcham, **ismi** Sardor.

sentences.text: I see **him** every day because **his** office is next to mine.
sentences.translation: **Uni** har kuni ko'raman, chunki **ofisi** menikining yonida.

sentences.text: Tom left **his** wallet in the taxi, so I lent **him** some money.
sentences.translation: Tom **hamyonini** taksida qoldiribdi, shuning uchun **unga** biroz qarz berdim.

sentences.text: This guitar isn't mine; it's **his**.
sentences.translation: Bu gitara meniki emas, **uniki**.

sentences.text: Grandad is a bit deaf, so please speak up when you talk to **him**.
sentences.translation: Bobomning qulog'i biroz og'ir, shuning uchun **u bilan** gaplashganda balandroq gapiring.

sentences.text: Where's James? **He** promised to help me today.
sentences.translation: Jeyms qayerda? **U** bugun menga yordam berishga va'da bergan edi.

sentences.text: Bekzod and **his** wife invited us to dinner.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **xotini** bilan bizni kechki ovqatga taklif qildi.

sentences.text: The man next to the window — do you know **him**?
sentences.translation: Deraza yonidagi kishi — **uni** taniysizmi?

sentences.text: My father loves **his** garden; **he** works in it every evening.
sentences.translation: Dadam **bog'ini** juda yaxshi ko'radi, **u** har kuni kechqurun bog'da ishlaydi.

sentences.text: When Aziz broke **his** leg, all **his** friends visited **him** in hospital.
sentences.translation: Aziz **oyog'ini** sindirib olganda, barcha **do'stlari** **uni** kasalxonada ko'rgani borishdi.

examples.title: **she**, **her**, **hers**
examples.description: Ayol haqida: **she** (u — ega), **her** (uni, unga — va uning + ot), **hers** («uniki»). **her** ikki vazifada keladi — keyingi so'zga qarang.

sentences.text: **She** works with **her** mother in a small bakery.
sentences.translation: **U** **onasi** bilan kichik novvoyxonada ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Madina is very kind. Everyone likes **her**.
sentences.translation: Madina juda mehribon. **Uni** hamma yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: I met **her** brother yesterday — he's really funny.
sentences.translation: Kecha **uning akasi** bilan tanishdim — juda kulgili yigit ekan.

sentences.text: The green bike by the door is **hers**.
sentences.translation: Eshik oldidagi yashil velosiped **uniki**.

sentences.text: Did you see **her**, or just **her** car?
sentences.translation: **Uning o'zini** ko'rdingizmi yoki faqat **mashinasini**?

sentences.text: My grandmother is eighty, but **she** walks to the market every day.
sentences.translation: Buvim sakson yoshda, lekin **u** har kuni bozorga piyoda boradi.

sentences.text: Emma can't come, so I'll call **her** later and tell **her** the news.
sentences.translation: Emma kela olmaydi, shuning uchun keyinroq **unga** qo'ng'iroq qilib, yangilikni aytaman.

sentences.text: Is that your scarf or **hers**?
sentences.translation: Bu sizning sharfingizmi yoki **unikimi**?

sentences.text: Our teacher gave us **her** email, so we can write to **her**.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchimiz bizga **elektron pochtasini** berdi, endi **unga** yozishimiz mumkin.

sentences.text: When Lola got married, **her** parents gave **her** a car.
sentences.translation: Lola turmushga chiqqanda, **ota-onasi** **unga** mashina sovg'a qilishdi.

sentences.text: **We** love **our** new flat; it's bright and quiet.
sentences.translation: **Biz** yangi **kvartiramizni** juda yaxshi ko'ramiz: u yorug' va sokin.

sentences.text: Could you take a photo of **us**, please?
sentences.translation: **Bizni** suratga olib bera olasizmi, iltimos?

sentences.text: That table by the window is **ours** — **we** booked it.
sentences.translation: Deraza yonidagi stol **bizniki** — **biz** uni oldindan band qilganmiz.

sentences.text: **Our** neighbours often invite **us** for tea.
sentences.translation: **Qo'shnilarimiz** **bizni** tez-tez choyga taklif qilishadi.

sentences.text: Your children go to School 5, and **ours** go to School 12.
sentences.translation: Sizning bolalaringiz 5-maktabda o'qiydi, **biznikilar** esa 12-maktabda.

sentences.text: **We** missed the last bus, so Aziz drove **us** home.
sentences.translation: **Biz** oxirgi avtobusga ulgurmadik, shuning uchun Aziz **bizni** uyga mashinada olib bordi.

sentences.text: In **our** village everybody knows everybody.
sentences.translation: **Qishlog'imizda** hamma bir-birini taniydi.

sentences.text: Excuse me, are these seats **ours**? — Let me check the tickets.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu o'rindiqlar **biznikimi**? — Chiptalarni tekshirib ko'ray.

sentences.text: **Our** teacher told **us** to bring **our** dictionaries.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchimiz **bizga** **lug'atlarimizni** olib kelishni aytdi.

sentences.text: When **we** were in London, a friend of **ours** showed **us** the city.
sentences.translation: Londonda bo'lganimizda, **bir do'stimiz** **bizga** shaharni ko'rsatdi.

examples.title: **they**, **them**, **their**, **theirs**
examples.description: «Ular» ning to'rt shakli: **they**, **them**, **their** + ot, **theirs**. Odamlar ham, narsalar ham (pomidorlar, kalitlar) — they / them.

sentences.text: **They** live on the third floor, and **their** windows face the park.
sentences.translation: **Ular** uchinchi qavatda yashashadi, **derazalari** parkka qaragan.

sentences.text: I haven't seen my cousins for years. I really miss **them**.
sentences.translation: Amakivachchalarimni necha yildan beri ko'rmayman. **Ularni** juda sog'indim.

sentences.text: These aren't our bags — they're **theirs**.
sentences.translation: Bu bizning sumkalarimiz emas — **ularniki**.

sentences.text: The students handed in **their** projects on time.
sentences.translation: Talabalar **loyihalarini** o'z vaqtida topshirishdi.

sentences.text: Where are the kids? — **They**'re in the garden with **their** dad.
sentences.translation: Bolalar qayerda? — **Ular** bog'da, **dadasi** bilan.

sentences.text: We paid for our tickets, but **theirs** were free.
sentences.translation: Biz chiptalarimizga pul to'ladik, **ularniki** esa bepul edi.

sentences.text: If your parents call, tell **them** I'll be late.
sentences.translation: Agar ota-onangiz qo'ng'iroq qilishsa, **ularga** kechikishimni ayting.

sentences.text: James and Sarah are coming, and **their** baby is coming with **them**.
sentences.translation: Jeyms bilan Sara kelishyapti, **chaqaloqlari** ham **ular bilan** keladi.

sentences.text: Tomatoes are cheap in summer, so I buy a lot of **them**.
sentences.translation: Yozda pomidor arzon, shuning uchun **undan** ko'p sotib olaman.

sentences.text: The neighbours have a big dog, and **they** walk **it** twice a day.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarning katta iti bor, **ular** **uni** kuniga ikki marta sayrga olib chiqishadi.

examples.title: Questions and answers: all four forms
examples.description: Savol → javob juftliklarida barcha shakllar aralash: savolda **your**, **you**, javobda **mine**, **me**, **his**, **theirs** ...

sentences.text: Is this **your** pen? — No, **mine** is blue.
sentences.translation: Bu **sizning** ruchkangizmi? — Yo'q, **meniki** ko'k.

sentences.text: Did **they** call **you**? — Yes, they called **me** last night.
sentences.translation: **Ular** **sizga** qo'ng'iroq qilishdimi? — Ha, kecha kechqurun **menga** qo'ng'iroq qilishdi.

sentences.text: Do you know **her** husband? — Yes, he's a friend of **mine**.
sentences.translation: **Uning erini** taniysizmi? — Ha, u **do'stlarimdan biri**.

sentences.text: Whose keys are these? — They're **his**. **He** always forgets them.
sentences.translation: Bu kimning kalitlari? — **Uniki**. **U** ularni doim unutib qoldiradi.

sentences.text: Can **we** sit with **you**? — Of course, **our** table is big.
sentences.translation: **Siz bilan** o'tirsak bo'ladimi? — Albatta, **stolimiz** katta.

sentences.text: Have you met **our** new neighbours? — Yes, I like **them** a lot.
sentences.translation: **Yangi qo'shnilarimiz** bilan tanishdingizmi? — Ha, **ular** menga juda yoqdi.

sentences.text: Who told **you** about the party? — Bekzod told **me**.
sentences.translation: Ziyofat haqida **sizga** kim aytdi? — **Menga** Bekzod aytdi.

sentences.text: Is that **their** dog? — Yes, it's **theirs**. **Its** name is Rex.
sentences.translation: Bu **ularning** itimi? — Ha, **ularniki**. **Ismi** Reks.

sentences.text: Where did **she** buy **her** dress? — I don't know; ask **her**.
sentences.translation: **U** **ko'ylagini** qayerdan olgan? — Bilmayman, **o'zidan** so'rang.

sentences.text: Are these **your** children? — No, **ours** are at home with **their** grandma.
sentences.translation: Bular **sizning** bolalaringizmi? — Yo'q, **biznikilar** uyda, **buvisi** bilan.

examples.title: Mixed: a story about two flatmates
examples.description: Kichik hikoya: barcha shakllar aralash. Har bir olmosh uchun o'zingizga savol bering — ega, to'ldiruvchi, egalik + ot yoki «-niki»?

sentences.text: My friend Sarah and **I** share a flat, and **our** flat is in central Manchester.
sentences.translation: Dugonam Sara **ikkalamiz** birga yashaymiz, **kvartiramiz** Manchester markazida.

sentences.text: **Her** room is quiet, but **mine** has a balcony.
sentences.translation: **Uning** xonasi sokin, **meniki** esa balkonli.

sentences.text: We cook together, and sometimes **her** friends join **us**.
sentences.translation: Biz birga ovqat pishiramiz, ba'zan **uning** do'stlari ham **bizga** qo'shilishadi.

sentences.text: Last week **her** brother visited **us** from Leeds.
sentences.translation: O'tgan hafta Lidsdan **akasi** **bizni** ko'rgani keldi.

sentences.text: **He** brought **his** guitar and played for **us** all evening.
sentences.translation: **U** **gitarasini** olib keldi va kechqurun bo'yi **bizga** chalib berdi.

sentences.text: Then **he** forgot **his** phone, and **I** found **it** under the sofa.
sentences.translation: Keyin **u** **telefonini** unutib ketdi, **men** **uni** divan ostidan topdim.

sentences.text: **I** texted **him**, and he replied: Yes, it's **mine**!
sentences.translation: **Men** **unga** xabar yozdim, u esa: «Ha, **meniki**!» deb javob berdi.

sentences.text: Now **he**'s coming back for **it** — and for another dinner with **us**!
sentences.translation: Endi **u** telefon **uchun** qaytib kelyapti — yana **biz bilan** kechki ovqat uchun ham!

sentences.text: Our landlord is a kind man; **his** wife often brings **us** cakes.
sentences.translation: Uy egamiz mehribon odam; **xotini** **bizga** tez-tez pirog olib keladi.

sentences.text: **They** live downstairs, and **their** cat often sleeps on **our** doormat.
sentences.translation: **Ular** pastki qavatda yashashadi, **mushuklari** esa ko'pincha **bizning** eshik oldidagi gilamchada uxlaydi.
